response.sql: WITH elig AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.ID FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.`U-PRO`) <> '' AND l.`U-PRO` <> '-'), per AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(1.0 * l.ALP / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM elig) GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_of_avg_pt, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM per GROUP BY SEX

assumptions.assumption: A U-PRO value counts as recorded only if it is non-NULL and not blank. Blank strings are excluded, along with '-'.
The per-record ratio is ALP/GPT in floating point. Records with GPT = 0 or NULL give a NULL ratio, which the average ignores.
SEX is grouped as stored, so a blank value forms its own group. A NULL SEX, if any, would also form its own group.

alternatives.interpretation: A blank-string U-PRO counts as a recorded result other than '-'. Only NULL and '-' are excluded.
